title: Clear a divisible first column while preserving the first row
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, m a natural number, and B a matrix indexed by Fin (m + 1) in both directions over R. Suppose B(0,0) divides B(i.succ,0) for every i : Fin m. There exists a matrix U of the same size, invertible under matrix multiplication, such that (UB)(0,j) = B(0,j) for every j : Fin (m + 1) and (UB)(i.succ,0) = 0 for every i : Fin m.
lean_statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R), (∀ i : Fin m, B 0 0 ∣ B i.succ 0) → ∃ U : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R, IsUnit U ∧ (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (U * B) 0 j = B 0 j) ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, (U * B) i.succ 0 = 0)
